author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes:
Beta: rule-to-rule relationships.

Shows when one rule runs another rule's actions, stops another rule's actions, or sets another rule's Private Boolean. Pick "Rule to rule only" in the Show filter to see just those.

Installs alongside the release version under its own name, so both can run on the same hub at once. Your existing Automation Map install is not touched.

This is a test build. Please report what you find on the community thread.
